one_line: CDN, DNS, security and edge-computing platform with one of the broadest REST APIs in the industry.
auth_notes: API tokens (scoped, recommended, Bearer) created in dashboard; OAuth2 for third-party apps; legacy global API key + email auth; token endpoints manage permissions and rolling
self_serve_notes: Free tier; API tokens self-serve from the dashboard with fine-grained permission groups; OAuth app registration available

api_surface.breadth_estimate: 10,000+ documented REST endpoints (accounts, zones, DNS, SSL, cache, WAF, workers, KV, R2, email, logpush, analytics) plus GraphQL analytics API
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks for notifications, Workers, and other products; also Workers as event-driven compute

existing_mcp.note: Cloudflare Workers MCP server is official (knowledge); community MCP servers exist; fetched text confirms very broad REST API and official SDKs (TS/Python/Go/Terraform)

evidence.note: fetched text confirms API reference, token endpoints, official SDKs and breadth

agent_notes: Huge API surface; scoped tokens make safe integrations straightforward.
